notes: Direct arithmetic covers all signed-int5 triples and all shared delta0..31; no new coefficient/model assumptions
Shared upper reconstruction tested as eleven-bit modular bit patterns; actual leakage output remains representable
Schedules are analytical before RTL replay; source window/memory handling still excluded
All delta0..31 and every pair of unsigned8 residuals; product fields cannot carry into each other
All int11 scalar high corrections; exact ceil((256-delta)*U/256) and representable metadata
Applied to adaptive and matched fixed pair/hybrid; not a one-sided optimization
Numerical screening only; controller, RTL mapping and timing not measured for this candidate
delta25 is the existing beta231 reference, not a newly chosen model
Each lane splits U=32*h+r; DSP C absorbs32*((delta*h)mod8), metadata stores U-floor(delta*h/8)
DSP output extraction then requires only subtracting its unsigned two-bit quotient; no separate fractional carry decoder
Any RTL trial must optimize the fixed full-range3 lane by the same algebra when delta<=25; controller savings cannot be inferred from comparison to the older unoptimized triple
Every delta0..31 and h=-2,-1,0,1; q_twoneg=-ceil(delta/4), q_neg=-ceil(delta/8)
All rounding tables are computed once per shared coefficient and selected by each membrane high part

limitations: Leakage primitive only; synaptic current, threshold, subtractive reset and classification reconstructed in Python
No memory-to-memory engine: source lookahead, pointer advance, bank rotation, state RAM and variable-count writeback are not routed
Three-read/write bandwidth is needed for three neurons per clock. Two-read/write state ports cap all variants at two updates per clock
Shared Q8 coefficient, delta0..31; per-neuron coefficient regrouping and larger coefficients excluded
Beta231 reference changes the saved trained model coefficients; output preservation is against that declared scalar reference
Only first48 held-out images of each of three saved seeds, not a full360-image RTL or newly trained/model-download run
Internal setup excludes raw input arithmetic. Boundary constraints1ns max/0.1ns min are applied after routing; port/clock-source assumptions are estimates
All boundary hold results are negative. No registered launch/capture timing fixture, system timing closure, board, power, energy or host measurement
Programmable hardware uses the same delta25 model replay for schedule comparison, not a different variable-coefficient SNN
Occupied slices are from one placement per design; they can vary with placement and constraints. Slice counts do not include a DSP-to-fabric area conversion
No FireFly reproduction or accelerator-level comparison; novelty absence has not been proved
